newsitem.title: UK: IPE confirms trading suspended due to power cut.
newsitem.headline: IPE confirms trading suspended due to power cut.

text.p: The International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) confirmed that trading was suspended at 1830 GMT on Friday due to a power outage that blanked the main price display board on the trading floor.
A spokeswoman for the exchange said they were uncertain when or if trading would resume on Friday.
"We are investigating the problem at the moment," she said.
Trade sources said the main lighting system had also been knocked out and the exchange had reverted to emergency lighting.
The Brent contract normally closes at 2015 GMT.
